collection.description: A nursing mother wants somewhere comfortable to feed her baby without being separated from village life.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (mother), a nursing (mother.mother/father), wants somewhere comfortable to feed (mother.his/her) baby without being separated from village life.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: (mother.He/She) enjoys the choice of privacy while remaining near friends.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: (mother.He/She) prefers feeding among the group, and everyone respects that too.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: (mother.He/She) requests water and a supportive seat rather than a separate area.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: (mother.He/She) asks for a hammock nearby for rest, with a safe separate sleep space for the baby.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: (friend) weaves a screen that can be moved as needed.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The group offers too many suggestions, and (mother.he/she) gently asks them to listen first.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: The corner becomes useful to several caregivers with different preferences.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: (mother) changes (mother.his/her) mind from day to day without anyone treating it as a problem.
